releaseNotes: v1.1.3: new tvButton remote button, the Siri Remote's TV button. One press follows the Apple TV's TV Button setting, two presses (times 2) open the App Switcher. Typing tv or tvbutton as a button name in a rule now presses the TV button (it used to go to the Home Screen; use homeScreen for that). New Tips topic: Home Screen vs TV button. No Done needed after updating.
author: jdthomas24
tags: Apple TV, TV, video, local control

apps.name: Apple TV Integration
apps.description: Finds Apple TVs on your network, pairs each with the PIN shown on the TV and creates one device per Apple TV.

drivers.name: Apple TV
drivers.description: One per Apple TV. On/off with live power state, playback controls, Siri Remote buttons (including the TV button), volume, app launching and now playing, over an encrypted local connection.
